description: This PHP source file defines the class OAuthCodeGrantManager which handles OAuth 2.0 authorization request management, including saving, loading, and validating authorization requests within a session context. It interacts with the OAuth2 server library, manages session variables, and enforces security validation patterns.

classes.name: OAuthCodeGrantManager
classes.description: Manages OAuth 2.0 authorization code grant flow, including session management, request validation, and interaction with authorization server.

methods.name: saveRequestToSession
methods.description: Saves OAuth authorization request parameters into session variables for later retrieval.

methods.name: loadAuthorizationRequest
methods.description: Loads and reconstructs an authorization request from session variables, validating data and creating an authorization request object.

methods.name: cleanupSession
methods.description: Removes OAuth session variables once processing is complete.

methods.name: validateConfirmationRequest
methods.description: Validates that an incoming request matches a stored OAuth authorization request, ensuring session and request parameters are consistent.

methods.name: getQueryParam
methods.description: Helper method to safely retrieve a specific query parameter from the request.
